about: Framing review: our own reading of each Wikipedia summary, shown next to it and never merged into it. It is an opinion, not a correction and not Wikipedia's view.
reviewer: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), an AI model made by Anthropic. Not checked line by line by a person.
